MooJai World — self-hosted vendor files

Files: three.module.min.js and its relative dependency three.core.min.js.

Supabase JS 2.119.2 (MIT)
Source: official npm package @supabase/supabase-js@2.119.2,
dist/umd/supabase.js. Loaded only for configured online worlds.
License: SUPABASE-LICENSE.txt
SHA256 supabase.js: 8816af04d9915dbba1882d6f84f0b402dc40268063a63d9c66d24f52f371c263

Keep files local and preserve license notices. No CDN is used at runtime.
The npm tarballs can be retrieved with npm pack at these exact versions.
The website needs no bundling step. Rule-engine copies live in _shared,
not here, and are checked for byte equality by the backend test suite.
